title: Tony weapon and special-attack ideas
status: Discussion notes only; not approved for implementation or registered as playable weapons
source: Two message screenshots supplied by Sean from Tony
overall_direction: Character special attacks and Contra-style floating weapon pickups are alternatives to discuss.

ideas.name: Kinetic air ram
ideas.concept: A blast of air damages an enemy and pushes it away.
ideas.visual_reference: Screenshot shows a cylindrical metal hand-operated drain air ram with pistol grip and black rubber nozzle.

ideas.name: Toilet auger
ideas.concept: Medium-range whip-like attack; Tony references Castlevania for attack feel.
ideas.relationship_to_existing_weapons: May overlap with the proposed drain snake; decide whether to revise that weapon or make a distinct tool.

ideas.name: Plunger water-wave special
ideas.concept: Plant the plunger on the ground and struggle against a large clog, then unleash a full-screen wave of water that damages or kills enemies.
ideas.ownership_note: Tony addresses Sean as your character; likely intended for Sean, but confirm later.

ideas.name: Three-foot pipe wrench
ideas.concept: A large melee weapon swung like a sword.
ideas.relationship_to_existing_weapons: May overlap with the existing pipe-wrench concept; size and character ownership remain open.

ideas.name: Drain-machine cable special
ideas.reference_equipment: Spartan 1065, named by Tony; reference only, not a final in-game brand or name
ideas.concept: Tony pulls out a drain machine and launches its cable across the screen. Powerful, strictly linear attack at his current elevation.
ideas.ownership_status: Suggested by Tony; not implementation approval

later_discussion: Which are regular weapons, temporary pickups, or character specials?
Exclusive ownership: assign each adopted weapon to Tony or Sean; preserve existing no-sharing rule.
Damage, reach, attack timing, knockback, ammo/charges, and cooldowns remain unspecified.
Define whether cable and wave pierce enemies, interact with platforms, or affect bosses.
Full-screen specials are separate proposals, not a reversal of approved short-range starter weapons.
Decide which ideas replace or extend existing wrench/drain-snake concepts.
implementation: No gameplay, balance, artwork assignments, or runtime catalog changes requested.
